items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 5 at 11:07PM AKST until November 6 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow, blowing snow and a glaze of ice. Additional snow
accumulations up to one inch. Total ice accumulations between a
trace and 0.05". Winds gusting as high as 50 mph.

* WHERE...Central Beaufort Sea Coast, Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast, and
Northern Arctic Coast.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. A Trace to 0.05" of ice will
make untreated surfaces slick. Areas of blowing snow could reduce
visibility below one half mile. Localized blizzard conditio
items.areas: Northern Arctic Coast; Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 5 at 8:55PM AKST until November 6 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 55 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Annette Island.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 5 at 8:55PM AKST until November 6 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Ketchikan Gateway Borough and Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...High winds will blow around unsecured objects, damage
property and cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.
items.areas: Prince of Wales Island; Ketchikan Gateway Borough
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 5 at 8:55PM AKST until November 6 at 12:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Sitka.

* WHEN...Until noon AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...High winds will blow around unsecured objects, damage
property and cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...There will then be a brief break Thursday
evening before winds increase again from the SW overnight into
Friday morning.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 5 at 8:55PM AKST until November 7 at 6:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 40 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Friday to 6 AM AKST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.
